# IC Business Systems

> Web design business in Lawrence, Massachusetts, run by Irving Carrion. Websites, Google Business Profile setup and request forms for plumbers, HVAC companies, other trades and owner-led local businesses. English and Spanish. Not affiliated with IC System, Inc.

- Based in Lawrence, MA. Meets clients in person across the Merrimack Valley (Methuen, Andover, North Andover, Haverhill, Lowell) and southern New Hampshire; works remotely with businesses anywhere.
- Builds custom-coded websites, or works on Squarespace when the owner wants to edit the site.
- Clients keep their own domain and accounts.
- Prices: websites by quote, consulting $75 an hour, monthly website support from $150 a month.

## Pages

- [Home (English)](https://icbusinesssystems.com/): services, live client sites, pricing, FAQ, free site review form
- [Inicio (español)](https://icbusinesssystems.com/es/): the same page in Spanish
- [Free website self-check](https://icbusinesssystems.com/audit.html): check a site in 90 seconds

## Services

Each service has its own page in English and Spanish (what's included, who it's for, how it works, honest limits, FAQ).

- [Websites for plumbers and HVAC companies](https://icbusinesssystems.com/websites-for-plumbers-hvac/): fast, phone-first, custom-coded sites for trades (español: https://icbusinesssystems.com/es/sitios-web-para-plomeros-hvac/)
- [Google Business Profile setup](https://icbusinesssystems.com/google-business-profile/): categories, services, service area, photos and posts; no fake reviews (español: https://icbusinesssystems.com/es/perfil-de-google-business/)
- [Suspended Google Business Profile help](https://icbusinesssystems.com/google-business-profile-suspended/): find the cause, fix the profile, file the appeal; real businesses only, Google decides every appeal (español: https://icbusinesssystems.com/es/perfil-de-google-suspendido/)
- [AI search check](https://icbusinesssystems.com/ai-search-check/): what ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI say about a local business, with a ranked fix list (español: https://icbusinesssystems.com/es/revision-de-busqueda-con-ia/)
- [Google Analytics and Search Console setup](https://icbusinesssystems.com/google-analytics-search-console-setup/): GA4 and Search Console that count calls and quote requests (español: https://icbusinesssystems.com/es/configuracion-google-analytics-search-console/)
- [Squarespace website fixes](https://icbusinesssystems.com/squarespace-website-fixes/): mobile layout, galleries, Fluid Engine sections, custom CSS and forms (español: https://icbusinesssystems.com/es/arreglos-sitio-squarespace/)
- [Website promo videos](https://icbusinesssystems.com/website-promo-video/): short videos built from a real site on a phone and a desktop (español: https://icbusinesssystems.com/es/video-promocional-de-sitio-web/)

## Case studies

- [S. Meredith Plumbing & Heating, Saugus MA](https://icbusinesssystems.com/work/s-meredith-plumbing/): a plumber's "coming soon" page replaced with a phone-first site, 10 service pages, 9 town pages, a work page from his own Instagram and a request form that emails the owner (español: https://icbusinesssystems.com/es/trabajos/s-meredith-plumbing/)
